hero.title: Take control of your money,
hero.subtitle: A clean, self-hosted budget tracker with multiple accounts, smart categories, monthly budgets, and dashboards that actually help you decide.
hero.tagline: Your data lives on your server. No tracking, no ads, no nonsense.

features.title: Everything you need to budget, nothing you don't.
features.subtitle: The essentials, done well. No upsell, no premium tier.

accounts.title: Multiple accounts
accounts.description: Track checking, savings, and cards side by side — each with their own currency and running balance.

categories.title: Smart categories
categories.description: Tag income and expenses to see exactly where your money comes from and where it goes.

budgets.title: Monthly budgets
budgets.description: Set per-category spending goals and watch overspend surface before the month is over.

recurring.title: Recurring transactions
recurring.description: Automate the predictable: rent, salary, subscriptions — log them once and forget.

csv.title: CSV import
csv.description: Pull statements straight from your bank with column mapping and built-in deduplication.

dashboards.title: Insightful dashboards
dashboards.description: Charts and stats that show trends, breakdowns, and the bottom line at a glance.

cta.title: Ready to plan smarter?
cta.description: Spin up an account and start tracking in under a minute. Your data stays on your server.

about.title: About
about.description: Version and build details about this instance of Centsible.
